text.base: The cart arrives. Seven cups. One is just tap water.
text.fear: The cart arrives too quietly. Seven cups. You count them twice.
text.curiosity: The cart arrives. Seven cups, and you want to know what the eighth would have been.
text.reverence: The cart arrives the way rain does. Seven cups.
text.defiance: The cart arrives. Seven cups. Nobody said you had to drink.

choices.label: MERCY — the facts, without the teeth
DISTILLATION — the lessons, not the footage
COMMUNION — pour yours into the shared jar

labels: TRADITION: Orphic gold lamellae (Petelia, Hipponion) — the springs of Lethe and Mnemosyne
FICTION: the Beverage Cart of the Dead, its cart, and its tap water
nodes.a11y: A beverage cart offers seven cups, described in turn: Lethe, Mnemosyne, Mercy, Distillation, Communion, tap water, or nothing.
nodes.fallback: The cart squeaks. Choose a cup, or don't.

text.base:
Before I pour — a formality. The form insists.

WHAT IS THE ONE THING YOU WOULD KEEP,
IF KEEPING WERE ALLOWED?

It is not allowed. The cup does not do exceptions.
But the form has a field, and the field is hungry,
and what you reach for first says more than the reaching.
text.fear:
Before I pour — a formality. The form insists.

WHAT IS THE ONE THING YOU WOULD KEEP,
IF KEEPING WERE ALLOWED?

It is not allowed. You knew that before you asked,
and you were already holding something behind your back.
text.curiosity:
Before I pour — a formality. The form insists.

WHAT IS THE ONE THING YOU WOULD KEEP,
IF KEEPING WERE ALLOWED?

It is not allowed, which you will have noticed makes the
question more interesting rather than less.
text.defiance:
Before I pour — a formality. The form insists.

WHAT IS THE ONE THING YOU WOULD KEEP,
IF KEEPING WERE ALLOWED?

It is not allowed. Answer anyway. Forms do not own you;
they only outlive you.

labels: TRADITION: Orphic lamellae — the initiate begs water of Memory before descending
FICTION: the keeping field, which keeps nothing
nodes.a11y: Before pouring the cup of forgetting, the Bard asks what one thing you would keep if keeping were allowed. Five options: a person, a lesson, a wound, a joke, or nothing.
nodes.fallback: What would you keep, if keeping were allowed? It isn't. Answer anyway.
